---
title: 'Install an Android build'
status: implemented
description: 'Open an Oore install page on an Android device and install its APK.'
---

Install an available APK after Oore authorizes an artifact-scoped delivery
capability. That capability lasts up to one hour and ends sooner when the
artifact itself expires.

## What you need

- Project access that allows artifact downloads.
- A completed build with an available APK.
- An Artifact delivery URL or External Access public URL that the Android
  device can reach.

## 1. Open the install page

1. Open the completed build.
2. Under **Artifacts**, select **Install** for the APK.
3. Select **Copy install page link** when you need to move the link from a
   desktop browser to the device.

The copied build-page URL still requires Oore sign-in and project access. Oore
creates the short-lived bearer capability only after an authorized user
selects **Install**. Share that resulting delivery URL only with the intended
tester.

## 2. Install on Android

1. Open the install page on the Android device.
2. Select **Install**. From a desktop browser, the same action is labeled
   **Download APK**.
3. If Android asks, allow the current browser or file manager to install
   unknown apps.
4. Open the downloaded APK and confirm installation.

You can turn off the browser's unknown-app permission again after the install.

## Verify the result

The application appears in the Android launcher and opens on the device.

## Troubleshooting

**Android blocks the APK**

Allow unknown-app installation for the browser or file manager that opened
this download, then retry.

**The install page says Artifact expired**

Run a new build. An expired artifact cannot create another install session.

**The install link cannot be opened on the device**

Confirm the configured Artifact delivery URL or External Access public URL is
reachable from that device, then create a fresh install session.

## Next step

Return to the build and [download another artifact](/build/distribute/download)
or test the installed application.
